title.narrative: Asivikelane: reducing the impact of Covid-19 on informal settlements by improving government water, sanitation and refuse removal.

description.narrative: To improve the quantity and quality of basic services to informal settlement residents in South Africas metropolitan municipalities (metros) and secondary cities.The key activity of Asivikelane will be to design, implement, write up and disseminate the above-mentioned assessments of informal settlement service delivery in local governments. To support these assessments we will conceptualize, write, design, print and disseminate analyses of the budget allocation and budget implementation.
